faqs.question: How long does local SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: It depends on the competition in your area and on what is missing. Profile and website fixes count once Google has seen them again; reviews and links build up over months, so measure calls and enquiries month by month.

faqs.question: Is Google Business Profile free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Creating and managing a Google Business Profile is free. Google also says there is no way to pay for a better local ranking; ads are a separate, paid product.

faqs.question: Do I need a website for local SEO?
faqs.answer: A profile can appear in the map results without a website, but a website helps: it describes each service in detail, ranks in the regular results, and gives other websites something to link to, which Google counts as prominence.
